The film's performance was mostly supported by the Hindi version, contributing to most of the earnings.

description: 'Drishyam 3', featuring Ajay Devgn, continues to draw audiences even after 36 days, accumulating a stunning Rs 587.42 crore globally, thus confirming its blockbuster status. title: 'Scene' BO day 1: Suriya, Naslen film opens with Rs 34.25 cr

Her production house, Purple Pebble Pictures, celebrates ten years of telling meaningful stories through regional cinema.
